composition_rule.A: probability frozen 2+PV controller would ACCEPT absent D5 channel-layer faults
composition_rule.H: probability frozen 2+PV controller would HOLD absent D5 channel-layer faults
composition_rule.Q: probability frozen 2+PV controller would QUARANTINE absent D5 channel-layer faults

channel_model.ell_A: per-active-channel ancilla loss probability during the shell epoch
channel_model.m: missed active-loss probability conditional on active loss

state_policy: no active channel loss: preserve the frozen 2+PV outcome; if spare alone is lost, ACCEPT remains possible but mark DEGRADED
any detected active channel loss: current attempt cannot ACCEPT and is converted to HOLD
exactly one detected active loss plus live spare and successful MOVE/reset/verify: RESTORED_HOLD, then rerun a fresh 2+PV attempt
two or more active channel losses: HOLD even if some replacement is possible
any missed active channel loss with no detected active loss: if 2+PV would ACCEPT, label UNSAFE_ACCEPT_POSSIBLE
frozen 2+PV data loss still causes QUARANTINE and dominates the channel layer
claim_rule: replacement improves readiness for a fresh retry; it does not retroactively validate the interrupted 2+PV attempt
